name: Blended-NeRF
aliases: Zero-Shot Object Generation and Blending in Existing Neural Radiance Fields
definition: A framework for editing a specific region of interest (ROI) in an existing NeRF scene based on text prompts and a 3D ROI box. It uses a pretrained language-image model (CLIP) to steer a NeRF generator model initialized with the existing scene's weights, blending the synthesized content with the original scene using volumetric blending.
